brand_voice: Rebellious, bold, confident, 'not for sale', minimal but overwhelming graphic impact, super hero

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl sm:text-7xl lg:text-[10vw] font-black tracking-tighter uppercase leading-none
hierarchy.h2: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-7xl font-bold tracking-tight uppercase

typography.guidelines: Avoid default fonts like Inter. Headings must be massive, tight, and punchy. Use Cabinet Grotesk for dramatic Awwwards-style typography. Use JetBrains Mono for technical specs (SEO, AEO, LLM). Never center-align paragraphs; rely on aggressive left-alignment and asymmetrical grids.

colors.guidelines: Pure black base for maximum contrast. Use the brand violet (#9D4CDD) strictly for accents, active states, 3D neon effects, and the logo brackets [NOT4SALE]. Do not paint large flat surfaces in violet. Use white text with high-contrast rules.

layout.guidelines: Use generous spacing. Rely on the 'Tetris' Bento Grid (Mode A) for the services and philosophy sections. Implement asymmetrical layouts. Containers with borders must have internal padding (p-8).

motion.scrolling: Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling is MANDATORY.
motion.page_transitions: Framer Motion for dark wipe effects between pages.
motion.scroll_reveals: Staggered text reveals (line by line) on scroll. Sections must compose themselves.
motion.three_js: React Three Fiber + Drei. Implement a 3D morphing glass/chrome abstract shape in the Hero that responds to scroll and mouse position. As the user scrolls, transition to wireframe or neon violet nodes representing AI/Growth.
motion.hover_effects: Magnetic buttons, custom cursor (a small violet dot that expands on hover), and image distortion on hover.

components.navigation: Sticky glass header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60). Must morph and reveal on scroll up, hide on scroll down. Logo on left: [NOT4SALE] with purple brackets. Hamburger menu for mobile, full links on desktop.
components.buttons: Sharp-edged, brutalist buttons. Default: bg-white text-black font-bold uppercase tracking-widest hover:bg-violet-600 hover:text-white transition-all.
components.cards: Bento style. 1px solid white/10 border, flat black surface, subtle violet inner glow on hover.
components.chat_widget: AI Marketing Assistant (Claude Sonnet 4.5). Floating bottom right, sleek dark glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-2xl), 1px violet border, pulsing dot.

images.description: Hyper-realistic cinematic 3d render of an abstract floating chrome and dark glass geometric shape with violet neon reflections. Use as hero texture or fallback for WebGL.
Macro photography of dark volcanic stone with electric violet neon line. Use for Philosophy / Case Studies background.
Cinematic wide shot of a futuristic minimalist office in the dark. Use for 'Chi Siamo' / About page header.
Abstract glowing purple nodes connecting in a 3d mesh. Use for Services Hub (SEO, AEO, LLM, Growth Hacking).

media.guidelines: Never use placeholders. Use these high-end generated abstract images combined with text-heavy brutalist layouts.

home.hero: Massive typography 'MARKETING · GROWTH · BRAND'. 3D Canvas in background (R3F).
home.services_preview: Bento grid scrolling horizontally or pinned scroll with cards stacking.
home.philosophy: Text heavy. 'we build the machine adapted to each client - no point showing a Ferrari to someone who likes a Fiat 500'. Massive quote, dark texture background.
home.footer: Giant [NOT4SALE] wordmark spanning the entire width. Links to Cattolica location.

services_hub.layout: Grid of services (Growth Hacking, SEO, AEO, GEO, Brand Strategy, Performance Marketing, Social, Content, Web Design, AI Marketing). Tech-focused, using mono font for tags.

about.layout: 4 founders presented via abstract representations or high-contrast dark portraits (use office_founders image), rebellious copy.

contact.layout: Minimalist brutalist form. Large input fields with bottom border only. Address: Cattolica, Emilia-Romagna, Italy.

seo_and_tech.guidelines: Ensure semantic HTML. Implement Next.js/React Helmet for dynamic meta tags (SEO, AEO, GEO). Inject structured JSON-LD data for LocalBusiness (Cattolica) and ProfessionalService.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup React with Tailwind, Framer Motion, Lenis, and @react-three/fiber.
2. Configure Tailwind with Cabinet Grotesk (sans), Satoshi (body), JetBrains Mono (mono) and the color palette.
3. Build the cinematic 3D hero first. If Three.js is too complex, use the hero_background image with intense Framer Motion parallax and a glassmorphism overlay.
4. Implement Italian language copy for all sections.
5. Build the AI Marketing Assistant widget (fixed bottom right).
6. Ensure every interactive element has a data-testid attribute.
7. DO NOT use Shadcn Card components; use raw pure HTML/Tailwind divs for the Bento Grid to maintain the brutalist/creative freedom.
